narrative: The most actionable insight is the high-volume complaints about product quality, which is not limited by price caps and therefore can be tackled through quality improvements or clearer product info. A surprising finding is the strong Reddit signal around styling versatility - 22% of Reddit mentions versus none in the app reviews - highlighting an emergent theme that isn’t captured in the usual fit or price discussions. Other areas such as fit, service reliability and occasion relevance also show promise, but their current "not enough data yet" status means we still need to validate them before committing resources. Overall, while price perception scores highest, we cannot use discounts, so focusing on product quality and the newly surfaced styling versatility theme offers the clearest non-price lever opportunity.
